views.name: icd10_procedures_codes_norm
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  pcs_code AS pcs_code,
  SAFE_CAST(NULLIF(order_number, '') AS STRING) AS order_number,
  is_header_code AS is_header_code,
  TRIM(short_description) AS short_description,
  TRIM(long_description) AS long_description
FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_codes.icd10_procedures_2019`
grain: pcs_code (one row per ICD-10-PCS code or header row)
views.description: Normalized ICD-10-PCS procedures dimension: one row per pcs_code with cleaned descriptive columns and an explicit header flag. Use when joining procedure codes to claims or aggregations or when filtering out header rows. | Use for: Look up descriptions for a list of PCS codes; Count or filter real procedure codes vs header rows; Join procedure descriptions to provider/procedure facts

views.name: hcpcs_latest_by_code_rank
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  HCPC AS hcpc,
  RECID AS recid,
  SEQNUM AS seqnum,
  LONG_DESCRIPTION AS long_description,
  SHORT_DESCRIPTION AS short_description,
  SAFE.PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', ACT_EFF_DT) AS act_eff_date,
  SAFE.PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', ADD_DT) AS add_date,
  SAFE.PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', TERM_DT) AS term_date,
  OPPS AS opps,
  PRICE1 AS price1,
  MCM1 AS mcm1,
  MCM2 AS mcm2,
  ACTION_CD AS action_cd,
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER(
    PARTITION BY HCPC
    ORDER BY
      SAFE.PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', ACT_EFF_DT) DESC NULLS LAST,
      SAFE.PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', ADD_DT) DESC NULLS LAST,
      SAFE.PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', TERM_DT) DESC NULLS LAST,
      RECID DESC NULLS LAST,
      SEQNUM DESC NULLS LAST
  ) AS recency_rank
FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_codes.hcpcs`
grain: hcpc, recid, seqnum (one row per HCPCS table row with a recency rank per hcpc)
views.description: Windowed HCPCS rows with a recency rank per HCPC code based on ACT_EFF_DT / ADD_DT / TERM_DT. Exposes a rank so callers can pick the most recent or historical versions by filtering on rank. Keep in mind date columns may be NULL; ordering prefers ACT_EFF_DT then ADD_DT then TERM_DT. | Use for: Select the latest HCPCS row per code for joins (WHERE recency_rank = 1); Audit historical versions of HCPCS codes; Compare pricing or op/pps assignments across versions

views.name: physicians_supplier_2013_provider_hcpcs_agg
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  npi AS npi,
  nppes_provider_last_org_name AS provider_name,
  nppes_provider_state AS provider_state,
  place_of_service AS place_of_service,
  hcpcs_code AS hcpcs_code,
  SUM(IFNULL(line_srvc_cnt, 0)) AS total_line_srvc_cnt,
  SUM(IFNULL(bene_unique_cnt, 0)) AS total_bene_unique_cnt,
  SUM(IFNULL(bene_day_srvc_cnt, 0)) AS total_bene_day_srvc_cnt,
  AVG(IFNULL(average_medicare_allowed_amt, 0)) AS avg_of_avg_medicare_allowed_amt,
  AVG(IFNULL(average_submitted_chrg_amt, 0)) AS avg_of_avg_submitted_charge_amt,
  AVG(IFNULL(average_medicare_payment_amt, 0)) AS avg_of_avg_medicare_payment_amt
FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.physicians_and_other_supplier_2013`
GROUP BY npi, provider_name, provider_state, place_of_service, hcpcs_code
grain: npi, place_of_service, hcpcs_code (one row per provider+place+hcpcs aggregated across source rows)
views.description: Aggregated measures per provider (npi) and HCPCS code for the 2013 physicians_and_other_supplier file. Exposes totals and averages and preserves keys for joining to provider dimensions or HCPCS references. | Use for: Compare provider activity by HCPCS (counts/payments) in 2013; Join to HCPCS dimension to get descriptions for top billed codes; Aggregate provider measures to state or provider-level summaries

views.name: home_health_agency_summary_2014

SELECT

  agency_name AS agency_name,
  street_address AS street_address,
  city AS city,
  state AS state,
  zip_code AS zip_code,
  total_episodes_non_lupa AS total_episodes_non_lupa,
  distinct_beneficiaries_non_lupa AS distinct_beneficiaries_non_lupa,
  total_hha_charge_amount_non_lupa AS total_hha_charge_amount_non_lupa,
  total_hha_medicare_payment_amount_non_lupa AS total_hha_medicare_payment_amount_non_lupa,
  average_age AS average_age,
  average_hcc_score AS average_hcc_score,
  male_beneficiaries AS male_beneficiaries,
  female_beneficiaries AS female_beneficiaries
FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.home_health_agencies_2014`
grain: provider_id (one row per home health agency in 2014 file)
views.description: Normalized Home Health Agencies 2014: one row per provider_id with key summary measures and demographic counts. Useful as the base provider table for joins to geographic or quality analyses. | Use for: Rank/home-health agencies by episodes or payments; Map agencies by state or city; Analyze beneficiary demographics or average HCC scores
